newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt rubber price hike decision postponed.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt rubber price hike decision postponed.

text.p: The Thai cabinet postponed a decision to approve the agricultural ministry's proposal to increase rubber intervention prices following objections from some ministers, a government official said on Wednesday.

At its meeting on Tuesday, the cabinet instead asked the National Rubber Policy Committee to consider the issue on Wednesday before the decision returns to the cabinet for final approval, the official said.

Deputy Agricultural Minister Krish Kongpetchara on Friday signed a memorandum of understanding with disgruntled rubber holders in the south, agreeing to their demands by promising that the government would raise the intervention price to 29.00 baht ($1.11) a kg from 27.50 baht previously.
But some ministers at the Tuesday meeting raised objections to the plan, saying the protest to demand the hike was engineered by the opposition, the official said.
They also said the intervention plan could cost the government between seven and 10 billion baht, according to the official.
